verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents a Model changelog that records every change under the user's name, with undo [cfo-ai-docs-23]. It also documents lineage back to the source line [cfo-ai-docs-11], user-editable assumptions [cfo-ai-docs-2], and one-line scenarios [cfo-ai-docs-14][cfo-ai-docs-6]. The docs never say the changelog is kept per scenario or that a scenario comparison surfaces the differing assumptions and their authors. missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption records, attribution of who changed each scenario's assumptions, an auditable side-by-side scenario comparison view, independent/hands-on corroboration.
